hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: study_id
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The phs for the given study. E.g. phs000007

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` #export STORAGE_TYPE='s3' #export S3_BUCKET='avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl'
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${study_id}/metadata/ ./input/${study_id}/rawData/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.manifest.*" --include "${study_id}*.xml" --include "*.json" --quiet python3 -m compliant_metadata.convert_compliant_data_dict --input-folder "input/${study_id}/rawData/" --output-file "output/${study_id}/metadata/${study_id}_${study_abv,,}_metadata.json" aws s3 cp ./output/${study_id}/metadata/${study_id}_${study_abv,,}_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${study_id}/metadata/${study_id}_${study_abv,,}_metadata.json aws s3 cp ./output/${study_id}/metadata/${study_id}_${study_abv,,}_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abv,,}/decoded_data/${study_id}_${study_abv,,}_metadata.json
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN unset STORAGE_TYPE unset S3_BUCKET
